description: Call any Agent402 tool by slug (find slugs with catalog.find or catalog.search). Payment is handled automatically: USDC via x402 if this server has a wallet key, otherwise free proof-of-work on eligible pure-CPU tools (no wallet needed). Wallet-keyed highlights: live search/answer, stock-quote, render, transcribe, memory, and the /v1 LLM gateway tiers.

params.description: Tool input parameters, matching the tool's inputSchema

slug.description: Tool slug from catalog.search, e.g. "search" or "unit-convert"

name: catalog.call

outputSchema.description: Envelope around the invoked catalog tool's native JSON result

result.description: Native tool output (shape depends on slug)

title: Run an Agent402 tool
